stage.note: Stage is for the parent company Treeverse/lakeFS (Tilde.run was an internal product/spin-off of lakeFS launched May 2026 and shut down July 2026, folded back into lakeFS Mount). No funding round specific to Tilde.run was ever announced; the only confirmed priced round found for the parent is the 2021 Series A. A later round could not be confirmed in the time available, so this may understate current stage.

note: Tilde.run was a discontinued agent-sandbox product (Show HN 2026-05-06, by lakeFS co-founder Oz Katz / user 'ozkatz') built by Treeverse, Inc., the Tel-Aviv company behind the open-source data-version-control project lakeFS. It was never publicly priced (free private preview only) and was shut down around 2026-07-01, with its work folded into lakeFS Mount (enterprise lakeFS). Funding/stage/investor data here describes the parent company lakeFS/Treeverse, not a standalone round for Tilde.run itself, since none exists. Separately, lakeFS announced it acquired DVC (another data-version-control project) in late 2025/early 2026, per lakeFS media-mentions page.
